paraphrased_constraints: Phase tends to zero at low output power and to a constant at high output power.
An amplitude-domain cubic has zero slope at zero and at its upper constant extension.
After scaling to dBm, the signed peak derivative equals AMtoPM at PwrAMtoPM.
The documented -5 degrees/dB at 10 dBm example approaches about -48.85 degrees.
The described phase response applies to the fundamental; arbitrary multitone or harmonic selection is not specified by this adapter.
